packageRules.description: The oldest Paper NeoSkript supports. Raising it drops every server still on it, so it's changed by hand.
Third-party actions run with the repo's secrets, so they're pinned to a commit (CodeQL flags tags, which can be moved); Renovate keeps the pins current. GitHub's own actions stay on tags.
Nothing is released yet and CI covers the build, so small updates merge themselves once it passes. Majors wait for a review.
